name: Reflective Gaussian Splatting
definition: A framework for real-time high-quality rendering of reflective objects with inter-reflection, using 2D Gaussian primitives, physically based deferred rendering with split-sum approximation, and Gaussian-grounded inter-reflection.
summary: Reflective Gaussian Splatting renders reflective objects with inter-reflections by using 2D Gaussian primitives and deferred shading to ensure view-consistent geometry.
